meta.description: Signature rules for Lightweight IDS (C port). Patterns rewritten to POSIX Extended Regular Expressions (compiled with REG_ICASE) — the Python version's PCRE syntax ((?i), \b, \s) is not supported by POSIX regex.h.
match_types: payload_regex   - POSIX ERE applied to raw payload bytes (NUL bytes replaced with a space before matching)
port_match      - flags traffic to/from a specific port
flag_match      - matches TCP flag combinations (e.g. NULL/FIN/XMAS scans)

rules.description: Common SQL injection tokens observed in HTTP payload

rules.description: Script injection tokens in HTTP payload
